# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 1.1.0

*2026-11-02, Odoo 13.0 - 20.0*

- New Print To window.
- Workstations.
- Shipping labels.
- More examples.

## 1.0.0

*2026-11-01, Odoo 13.0 - 20.0*

- First release: print agents, printers, print rules, automatic printing, print jobs, the printer menu in the top bar and the Novator Print Agent.
